correctness.rationale: Translation/sign-symmetry/positive-homogeneity reduce every competitor to (1,t), 0≤t≤1; the four disjoint sign cases prove a pointwise inequality; medians bound each positive-coordinate count by k; the summed certificate equals t/(k+1)≥0. Even n uses the median ℓ1-optimum and norm comparison. Exact three-location witnesses attain all constants. The optimal Chebyshev facility exists via the independent 45-degree ℓ1 rotation. Exact-rational program exhausts 92,368 3×3-grid multisets n=2..10, 7,500 seeded random profiles and 38,808 pointwise certificate instances. All claims about arbitrary real profiles rest on the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-n exact minimax ratio is a natural primary performance measure for a standard strategyproof facility rule, not an arbitrary numerical slice. It resolves the population-size content omitted by the population-uniform sharp factor 2: each odd population has a strict and attained improvement, while every even size saturates 2, with a fully motivated geometric mechanism and a reproducible exact-optimum computation. The n=3 and n=5 gaps are sizeable (3/2 and 5/3 versus 2). It does not purport to beat optimally designed strategyproof mechanisms.
